question.text: $f(x)$ is real valued function such that $2 f(x)+3 f(-x)=15-4 x$ for all $x \in R$. Then $f(2)=$

solution.text:
$2 f(x)+3 f(-x)=15-4 x$...(1)
Replace $x$ by $-x$
$2 f(-x)+3 f(x)=15+4 x$ ...(2)
After solving (1) and (2), we get
$\begin{array}{l}
f(x)=4 x+3 \\
\therefore f(2)=8+3=11
\end{array}$
